Coram:

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJEEV NARULA  ORDER % 05.05.2025 CRL.M.A. 13656/2025 (seeking exemption from filing the originals/ certified copies and true typed copies of the documents)
1. Exemption is granted, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The Applicant shall file legible and clearer copies of exempted documents, compliant with practice rules, before the next date of hearing.
3. Accordingly, the application stands disposed of.

4. The present petition filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeks quashing of FIR No. 56/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S. Dabri and all proceedings emanating therefrom.
5. The Petitioners are father-in-law and mother-in-law of Respondent No. 3 Their son, who married Respondent No. 3, on 5th October, 2016 This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 29/06/2025 at 18:11:31 deceased few years later on 11th January, 2023.
It is pointed out that there was a settlement between deceased husband and Respondent No. 2 in respect of legal proceedings.

The fact of the settlement Prabhudayal Bunkar & Anr vs State (Nct Of Delhi) & Ors on 5 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165552892/
1 between the parties was taken on note by the Supreme Court in Transfer Petition(Civil) No.
314/2021 disposing of the same with following observations:
"At the commencement of hearing, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner (wife) states that the matrimonial dispute between the parties has been amicably settled and the Transfer Petition has become infructuous.

entities.text: Prabhudayal Bunkar & Anr vs State (Nct Of Delhi)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, the Transfer Petition is dismissed as infructuous."
6. However, subsequent to the death of their son, the proceedings arises from impugned FIR could not be closed.
It is thus argued that since there is a settlement between the parties, the FIR should be quashed.
7. On a specific query of the Court, counsel for the Petitioner states that they are not in communication with Respondent No.3 any longer.
In such circumstances, let Respondent No. 3 be also served through the Investigating Officer, returnable on the next date of hearing.
8. Till the next date of hearing, personal appearance of the Petitioners is exempted.
The Petitioner shall appear before the Trial Court through their counsel.

9. Re-notify on 23rd July, 2025.
SANJEEV NARULA, J MAY 5, 2025/ab
